game_concept: A action defense set in The Kingdom – Royal Stables, the royal stables: the royal scribe must handle goblin raiders while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Counter Tower: Increase a counter variable every time grain sacks reach the royal seal, stacking the tower higher.
theme: The Kingdom – Royal Stables: the royal stables
core_gameplay_loop: In Royal Stables, repeat each round: Increase a counter variable every time grain sacks reach the royal seal, stacking the tower higher. Each round, goblin raiders strike the royal seal, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the delivered value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the royal seal from goblin raiders in Royal Stables: keep the delivered meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 71-second timer ends.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: delivered drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 71-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 8 (extended tier): Counter Tower
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Counter Tower' (Week 1 slot 3), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Royal Stables'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how delivered changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against goblin raiders in Royal Stables.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 71 seconds while delivered > 0.
